g.text: Do the enzymes that would use a broadly-listed N class rise with the transporter?

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each point is one broadly-listing transporter × one N class it lists: x = the transporter's median protein rank percentile, y = the median for the genes in the genome with a KEGG reaction on that class's listed compounds. Dashed 0.5 = genome middle; dotted 0.9.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Excluded as known false positives: gst PMM0110, gst PMM0566, gst PMM0630, sodX PMM1295. Not detected in protein (no x): glcH PMM1323. Source: data/explore/e4_system_class_enzymes.csv (Cysteine / L-Cysteine merged).
